project_name: Veterans of Puerto Plata Clinic Dashboard
theme: Light mode primary (medical data clarity), Dark mode supported. Calming and professional.

headings.rule: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers to maintain a solid, trustworthy appearance. Never use Inter for headings.

body.rule: Crisp and highly legible for dense medical data, CPT codes, and progress notes. Use standard tracking.

colors.strategy: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm). No neon. Flat matte colors.
rules: No full-screen gradients. Medical UIs require absolute optical clarity.
Never use pure black #000000. Use deep forest #112218 instead.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text, specifically in the billing/CPT tables.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Medical Protocol: Use Flat Solid surfaces. STRICTLY NO GLASSMORPHISM. Glassmorphism creates refraction and reduces clinical readability. Use bg-white or bg-tan-50.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (border-border or border-black/5). No soft fuzzy dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active cards, none for static data tables. Flat, cardless design preferred for data grids.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. rounded-md or rounded-lg (max 8px). Do not use pill-shapes except for status badges.

grids_and_layouts.bento_strategy: High Density Grid for Dashboards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
dashboard_rules: Progressive Disclosure: Show primary metrics (e.g., 'Unread Messages', 'Pending Notes') at the top.
Max 9 widgets per screen to avoid cognitive overload.
F-Pattern Information Architecture: Place the North Star Metric in the top-left quadrant.
Global language toggle (EN/ES) must be clearly visible in the top right nav.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar navigation for scaling (Patients, Calendar, Notes, Invoices, Forms, Messages).
grids_and_layouts.data_tables: Flat tables with alternating faint row colors (bg-transparent and bg-tan-50/50). Sticky headers for long lists.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized to strip the 'Vercel' look, adopting a 'Flat solid clinical' aesthetic.
components.buttons: Rectangular with slight rounded corners (rounded-md). Solid fill for primary (bg-moneygreen-600). Hover state must be explicit (hover:bg-moneygreen-700 hover:text-white).
components.inputs: Flat backgrounds (bg-white), 1px solid borders (border-stone-200), focus:ring-moneygreen-500. Add search icons inside inputs where appropriate.
components.dialogs: Used for digital forms and quick progress notes. Solid white background, a clear close button, and dim solid backdrop (bg-black/40).
components.toasts: Sonner (sonner.js or sonner.jsx). Position top-right. Used for 'Note saved', 'Invoice generated', 'Message sent'.

motion.strategy: Minimalist, micro-interactions for feedback. No distracting bouncy animations.
interactions: Hover states for all table rows and buttons (transition-colors duration-200).
Smooth entrance for lists/cards using staggered fade-ins (framer-motion, opacity 0 to 1, y: 5 to 0).

media_and_icons.icons: lucide-react (Standard weight, crisp edges) for medical UI.

login_background.description: Abstract tan and green calming nature texture, ideal for auth screen split layout.

doctor_avatar_1.description: Friendly male doctor in blue scrubs. Use for user profile placeholder.

doctor_avatar_2.description: Friendly female doctor in white coat. Use for internal messaging avatars.

clinic_desk.description: Doctor at clinic desk. Can be used in 'Welcome' or 'About' cards on dashboard.

libraries.charts: recharts (for patient demographics or revenue metrics, utilizing the tan/green palette).

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Always explicitly set text color on hover - never rely on inheritance.
Do NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Ensure contrast ratio meets APCA standards. Text over images must have a solid or gradient backdrop.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md with solid/outline) with explicit interaction states.
Do not use default generic centering (.App { text-align: center }). Left-align forms, data, and dense content for readability.
Include a visible global Navigation bar/Sidebar at all times.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Shadcn UI components for Tables, Calendars (for appointments), Select, Dropdowns, Dialogs, and Tabs using .js/.jsx extensions instead of .tsx.
2. Implement a global state or Context for the English/Spanish language toggle affecting the UI.
3. Build a persistent F-pattern sidebar navigation containing links to: Dashboard, Patients, Appointments, Notes, Invoices, Forms, Messages.

4. For the 'Progress Notes' section, include a distinct UI area labeled 'AI Summarization' (perhaps highlighted with the money-green accent) to clearly delineate AI-generated content from manual notes.
5. Do NOT apply global transitions in CSS (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transition utility classes (e.g., transition-colors) only to interactive components.
6. Avoid standard default SaaS blue. Inject the custom tan and money-green palette deeply into Tailwind config and Shadcn overrides.
7. Construct the Medical Dashboard using pure grid utility classes (e.g., grid-cols-4) with max 9 widgets per screen to prevent visual clutter.
8. Ensure the design supports distinct role-based views for doctors, nurses, receptionists, and billers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' by strictly following the typographic hierarchy (Manrope + IBM Plex Sans) and the specific tan/green color palette.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Keep colors flat and solid.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs in this JSON.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, thought bubble, bulb, crystal ball, dart for icons. Use `lucide-react` icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create new components matching existing styles when necessary.
